This directory contains the files used by 86Box from the
[Adafruit SdFat fork](https://github.com/adafruit/SdFat) at commit
`20f3ffa005c1db4e8184735329afbf7e5c90a66a`.

The sources retain their upstream layout and contents. The floppy CMake
target selects the FAT filesystem sources and configures them for use with
an in-memory block device. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md) for the upstream license.
